# Freshboard

> Freshboard is digital menu board software for restaurants. A restaurant keeps its menu in one place, and when it publishes a change, the new prices and dishes appear on the TV menu boards in the restaurant and on its website menu at the same time. Google Business Profile menu updates are coming soon. Freshboard is made by Watt Consulting LLC in Washington, USA.

Key facts:

- Price: $39.99 a month for each location, with unlimited screens, edits and publishes. 14-day free trial, no card needed, no setup fees, cancel any time.
- Who it's for: restaurants, cafés, bars, bakeries, food halls and quick-service counters with menus on TVs, from one location to many.
- Menu boards: 110 designs and 50 fonts with your logo, horizontal or vertical TVs, a menu for each screen, and daily specials boards with dish photos.
- Dayparts: breakfast, lunch, happy hour and late-night menus switch on their own at set times, with countdowns such as "Happy hour ends in 20 min".
- Website: a menu page for each location, or an embed for the restaurant's own site, updated with every publish.
- Locations: one shared menu with different prices or sold-out items per location.
- Add-ons: allergen and dietary lookup by QR code (filters such as gluten-free, nut-free and vegan, worked out from one ingredient list), menu A/B testing on screens, and social post drafting for Instagram, Facebook, X and TikTok.
- Sign up: https://app.freshboard.org/app?signup
